review_candidates.description: Importante realtà operante nel settore della manutenzione e nuova realizzazione di infrastrutture di trasporto , attiva attraverso un articolato portafoglio di commesse pubbliche , è alla ricerca di un/una Direttore Tecnico da inserire presso la sede di Roma . Posizione La risorsa, riportando direttamente alla Direzione Generale , avrà la responsabilità della direzione e del coordinamento della struttura tecnica, composta da 6 Responsabili di Area territoriale , e sarà chiamata a garantire il presidio tecnico, organizzativo ed economico delle commesse, con una visione complessiva del portafoglio lavori. La risorsa sarà chiamata a svolgere, tra le altre, le seguenti attività : Direzione e coordinamento della struttura tecnica: coordinamento dei 6 Responsabili di Area territoriale, definizione delle priorità, monitoraggio delle attività e verifica dell'adeguatezza delle risorse rispetto al portafoglio lavori; Gestione del portafoglio commesse: supervisione complessiva delle commesse in essere, con particolare attenzione ad avanzamento, criticità, marginalità, fabbisogno di risorse e rispetto degli obiettivi aziendali; Pianificazione e programmazione: impostazione e controllo dei programmi lavori, monitoraggio dell'avanzamento delle attività, individuazione tempestiva di ritardi e criticità e definizione delle relative azioni correttive; Analisi di progetti e documentazione tecnica: capacità di comprendere e analizzare progetti, capitolati, computi metrici, contratti e documentazione tecnica di gara e di commessa; Gestione delle progettazioni: supervisione delle progettazioni, delle modifiche progettuali in corso d’opera e delle relative implicazioni economiche e temporali; SAL e controllo economico: supervisione della corretta predisposizione e gestione degli Stati di Avanzamento Lavori, con attenzione all'andamento economico e alla marginalità delle commesse; Gestione di tecnici, subappaltatori e fornitori: coordinamento delle risorse tecniche interne e supervisione dei rapporti con subappaltatori e fornitori, assicurando il rispetto di tempi, procedure, standard qualitativi e obblighi contrattuali; Rapporti con gli interlocutori di commessa: gestione dei rapporti con Direzioni Lavori, RUP, stazioni appaltanti, progettisti, consulenti e altri interlocutori tecnici e istituzionali; Gestione delle criticità di commessa: capacità di intervenire tempestivamente nelle situazioni problematiche, assumendo decisioni operative anche in condizioni di pressione e garantendo il rispetto di tempi, procedure e impegni contrattuali; Riserve e contenzioso tecnico: coordinamento della gestione delle riserve, delle richieste di proroga dei tempi contrattuali e delle problematiche tecnico-economiche, in collaborazione con l'Ufficio Legale; Collegi Consultivi Tecnici: collaborazione con l'Ufficio Legale nella gestione dei rapporti e della documentazione relativa ai Collegi Consultivi Tecnici; Sicurezza: supervisione degli aspetti tecnici connessi alla normativa in materia di salute e sicurezza sul lavoro, con particolare riferimento al D.Lgs. 81/2008; Codice dei Contratti Pubblici: applicazione e aggiornamento rispetto alla normativa vigente in materia di contratti pubblici e alle relative procedure; Gestione delle risorse tecniche: analisi dei fabbisogni di organico delle strutture di cantiere, individuazione tempestiva delle carenze e proposta di interventi organizzativi e di potenziamento; Accordi quadro e sviluppo del portafoglio: monitoraggio degli accordi quadro in essere e individuazione degli accordi che necessitano di essere alimentati attraverso nuovi contratti applicativi, contribuendo attivamente, anche nei rapporti con le stazioni appaltanti, alla promozione e allo sviluppo delle opportunità; Coordinamento interfunzionale: collaborazione con Ufficio Amministrazione Finanza e Controllo, Ufficio Gare, Ufficio Legale e Direzione per assicurare un efficace coordinamento delle attività e una corretta gestione delle problematiche tecniche, economiche e contrattuali; Reporting alla Direzione Generale: condivisione periodica dell'andamento del portafoglio lavori, delle principali criticità, dei fabbisogni organizzativi e delle opportunità di sviluppo. Requisiti Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria, preferibilmente Civile, Edile o equivalente; Almeno 10 anni di esperienza in ruoli di responsabilità tecnica e/o coordinamento nell'ambito delle costruzioni e delle infrastrutture; comprovata esperienza reale di cantiere, maturata sul campo e non esclusivamente in ambito progettuale o di studio; esperienza nella gestione di commesse complesse nell'ambito di lavori pubblici e infrastrutturali; conoscenza approfondita del Codice dei Contratti Pubblici e della normativa applicabile alle commesse; conoscenza della normativa in materia di sicurezza, con particolare riferimento al D.Lgs. 81/2008; capacità di lettura e comprensione di progetti, capitolati, computi metrici e documentazione tecnica; conoscenza di materiali, tecnologie costruttive e norme tecniche; competenza nella gestione di programmi lavori, varianti, SAL, riserve e richieste di proroga; capacità di controllo di costi, avanzamento e marginalità delle commesse; esperienza nel coordinamento di tecnici, subappaltatori e fornitori; capacità di gestione dei rapporti con Direzioni Lavori, RUP, stazioni appaltanti e altri interlocutori di commessa; spiccate capacità di leadership, coordinamento e gestione delle risorse; ottime capacità organizzative, di pianificazione e di problem solving; capacità di mediazione e gestione delle criticità, con attitudine a prendere decisioni anche in situazioni di pressione; capacità di avere una visione complessiva del portafoglio lavori, valutando fabbisogni di risorse, capacità produttiva e priorità delle diverse commesse; ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative e capacità di interagire efficacemente con la Direzione Generale e con i vertici aziendali delle Committenti (ANAS, ASPI, RFI, ecc.); ottimo standing professionale, autorevolezza e capacità di rappresentare l'azienda nei confronti degli interlocutori esterni; disponibilità a trasferte sul territorio nazionale; proattività, affidabilità, concretezza e forte orientamento al raggiungimento degli obiettivi; disponibilità a un aggiornamento continuo su normativa, tecnologie e dinamiche del settore.

review_candidates.title: Director, PMO
review_candidates.description: Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara. We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure. By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future. Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe. Director, PMO As Neara scales globally, we are investing in the operational rigor required to maintain excellence across an increasingly complex portfolio of customer engagements. To that end, we are hiring a Director, PMO for our European business: a position dedicated to software delivery and project management excellence, internal and customer training, and maintaining the connective tissue between our customer value, solutions and engineering teams. PMO is a new team that you will shape and operationalize, owning several critical functions which have to date, either operated in a more disaggregated manner or not existed at all. This is an exciting opportunity to build an important part of the Neara engine, with scope to influence global operations strategy as a senior member of the team in one of our fastest growing markets. What You Will Do Manage end-to-end project delivery for a portfolio of complex, high-value enterprise software engagements, from kickoff through go-live and handover. Apply and reinforce project management best practices and standards across your projects, setting the bar for how implementations should run. Maintain accurate, up-to-date project tracking and reporting - status, risks, milestones, and value delivery - and roll it up into team-level rituals and leadership dashboards. Identify risks and blockers early, and drive them to resolution by coordinating across Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. Partner with leadership and the wider CS team to refine PMO tooling, templates, and reporting infrastructure as the function matures. Support contract and scope reviews with Product and Engineering to ensure projects are resourced and configured for success from the start. Design and maintain Customer Success team onboarding and continuous learning systems. Who You Are 5+ years of experience across Customer Success, Professional Services, or PMO, with deep experience driving complex software implementations, delivery excellence, or PMO strategy. Direct experience managing enterprise software projects or large-scale transformation programs, with a clear understanding of what makes complex projects succeed or fail. Track record of applying, and improving, project management standards and processes rather than just operating within an existing framework. Comfortable working at multiple altitudes: following a defined methodology one day, unblocking execution on the ground the next. Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex project status, risks, and trade-offs into clear narratives for senior leadership and customers. Comfortable with data and tooling - able to build and maintain (automated) reporting, dashboards, and tracking systems, and confident working with project management tools (e.g., Fibery, Jira, Asana, or similar). Experience within infrastructure, and specifically the energy sector, is a plus but not essential. Fluent in English (must) and other European languages (preferred). What We Offer This is a rare opportunity to help stand up a brand-new PMO function for Neara. You will run some of our most important customer implementations while directly shaping the standards and tooling that scale our customer success operations in our largest market. Based in Europe, you will be a key part of our strategic growth in this market and drive the development of a self sustained business. Work on technology that matters. Our physics-enabled digital twins are actively protecting global energy grids from increasingly common weather events and structural failure, meaning your operational excellence directly translates to a more resilient world. You will have the strategic autonomy to influence global operations, paired with a collaborative culture where everyone, from engineering to leadership, is accessible and aligned on the same mission.

National Grid is hiring a Director of Digital Strategy, Governance and Portfolio to join our team in Warwick or London, with hybrid working. You'll play a key role in leading portfolio planning, prioritisation, and governance, ensuring strategic initiatives are aligned to business objectives and deliver maximum value across the organisation. About The Role This is a unique opportunity to lead the CIDO Office, the strategic function at the heart of NGET’s Digital & IT organisation. Acting as a trusted partner to the Chief Information & Digital Officer (CIDO), you'll play a pivotal role in shaping strategy, driving performance, and ensuring delivery of a digital agenda that supports one of the UK’s most critical infrastructure organisations. You'll be responsible for translating current and future regulatory investment plans, including T3 and subsequent regulatory periods, into tangible business, regulatory and financial outcomes. Working across a complex stakeholder landscape, you'll orchestrate Digital & IT contributions to major regulatory submissions, ensuring commitments, evidence, dependencies and value cases are aligned, compelling and deliverable. This is a highly visible leadership role, offering the opportunity to influence investment decisions, drive benefits realisation, assure delivery performance, and help shape the future of NGET's digital transformation journey. What You'll Do As Director of Digital Strategy, Governance and Portfolio, you'll sit at the centre of NGET's Digital & IT organisation, ensuring our most critical investments deliver measurable value for the business, customers, and the UK's energy future. Working closely with the CIDO and senior leaders across the organisation, you'll drive performance, shape strategy, and provide the governance needed to successfully deliver a complex and ambitious technology agenda. In This Role, You Will Lead performance across NGET's Digital & IT portfolio, ensuring strategic programmes deliver committed business, regulatory, and financial outcomes. Oversee the Digital & IT investment plan across T3 and future regulatory periods, balancing priorities, investment decisions, delivery confidence, and benefits realisation. Ensure more than £300m of committed benefits are effectively governed, tracked, and realised, intervening where required to keep delivery on course. Drive executive-level governance, enabling data-driven investment decisions that focus resources on the initiatives that create the greatest value. Lead regulatory assurance and performance reporting, coordinating Digital & IT contributions into major regulatory submissions and ensuring commitments are robust, evidenced, and deliverable. Shape the future direction of Digital & IT by influencing strategy, operating models, governance frameworks, and organisational capability. Partner with executive, regulatory, and business stakeholders to resolve complex challenges and navigate trade-offs across affordability, risk, capacity, and value. Foster a culture of accountability, performance, and continuous improvement, ensuring Digital & IT delivers sustainable outcomes for the organisation. review_candidates.title: Director de ventas
review_candidates.description: DIRECTOR COMERCIAL / DIRECTOR DE VENTAS Oportunidad para construir una nueva marca y un nuevo proyecto empresarial No buscamos simplemente cubrir un puesto de Director Comercial. Buscamos a alguien con quien construir un negocio. En CT Global Trading queremos conocer a profesionales senior con una amplia trayectoria comercial y, sobre todo, con un conocimiento profundo de un sector concreto . Personas que después de años trabajando en una industria puedan decir: “Conozco este mercado. Sé qué productos funcionan, quién compra, cómo se distribuye, quiénes son los principales actores y dónde existen oportunidades.” Nuestro objetivo es unir ese conocimiento con nuestras capacidades para identificar una oportunidad, desarrollar productos, crear una nueva marca y construir conjuntamente un proyecto empresarial con vocación de crecimiento. ¿Qué aporta CT Global Trading? Contamos con experiencia en dos áreas clave: IMPORTACIÓN Y DESARROLLO DE PRODUCTO • Búsqueda y selección de fabricantes en China. • Desarrollo y adaptación de productos. • Negociación con proveedores. • Compras y comercio internacional. • Importación, logística y operaciones. • Desarrollo de packaging y producto. MARCA, MARKETING Y COMERCIALIZACIÓN • Creación de nuevas marcas. • Naming, identidad y posicionamiento. • Estrategia de producto. • Marketing digital y publicidad. • E-commerce y canales de venta online. • Estrategia comercial y de comunicación. • Lanzamiento y posicionamiento en mercado. ¿Qué perfil buscamos? Nos interesa especialmente conocer profesionales que hayan desarrollado su trayectoria como: • Director/a Comercial. • Director/a de Ventas. • Director/a de Desarrollo de Negocio. • Director/a de Compras. • Category Manager. • Gerente o empresario/a de un sector. • Responsable Comercial. • Profesional senior con una trayectoria relevante dentro de una industria concreta. El cargo es secundario. Lo realmente importante es el conocimiento del mercado. Buscamos a alguien que conozca profundamente: • Los productos de su sector. • Los principales fabricantes y proveedores. • Los distribuidores y canales de venta. • Los clientes y sus necesidades. • La competencia. • Los márgenes y dinámicas comerciales. • Las tendencias del mercado. • Y, especialmente, las oportunidades que todavía no están bien explotadas . ¿Qué queremos construir? La idea es trabajar conjuntamente para: Detectar oportunidades reales dentro de un mercado. Identificar categorías y productos con potencial. Analizar competencia, precios, márgenes y canales. Buscar y desarrollar los productos con fabricantes. Crear una nueva marca desde cero. Diseñar su posicionamiento, identidad y packaging. Construir la estrategia comercial y de distribución. Lanzar la marca en España. Desarrollar una red de clientes y distribuidores. Escalar posteriormente el proyecto a otros mercados. ¿Qué buscamos en la persona? Más allá de la experiencia profesional, buscamos: • Mentalidad empresarial. • Capacidad para detectar oportunidades. • Conocimiento comercial real. • Una buena red dentro de su sector. • Capacidad de negociación. • Visión estratégica. • Autonomía. • Ambición por construir algo desde cero. Y, sobre todo, ganas de convertir años de experiencia y conocimiento de mercado en un proyecto propio. ¿Qué ofrecemos? La posibilidad de participar desde el origen en la creación y desarrollo de una nueva empresa y una nueva marca. No planteamos únicamente una relación laboral tradicional. Buscamos encontrar a una persona con la que exista complementariedad: Tú aportas el conocimiento profundo del mercado y su canal comercial. Nosotros aportamos desarrollo de producto, importación, proveedores, marca, marketing y capacidad de lanzamiento. La fórmula de colaboración, participación y condiciones económicas se definirá conjuntamente en función de la experiencia, implicación y aportación al proyecto. ¿Puede ser para ti? Esta oportunidad puede ser especialmente interesante si: • Llevas años trabajando en un sector y lo conoces en profundidad. • Tienes una red sólida de clientes, distribuidores o proveedores. • Detectas constantemente productos o categorías que podrían hacerse mejor. • Te has planteado alguna vez desarrollar tu propia marca o empresa. • Quieres dar un paso hacia el emprendimiento sin empezar completamente desde cero. • Buscas una nueva etapa profesional con mayor participación en las decisiones y en el crecimiento del negocio. Si conoces un mercado mejor que la mayoría y tienes claro que dentro de él existen oportunidades por desarrollar, queremos hablar contigo. Envíanos tu CV o perfil de LinkedIn acompañado de unas líneas contándonos: — En qué sector has desarrollado tu trayectoria. — Qué experiencia y conocimiento tienes del mercado. — Y qué tipo de oportunidad o proyecto crees que podría tener sentido desarrollar. review_candidates.description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships. The opportunity Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own. This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made. You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life. Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience. Write complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, built with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, and brief them into the performance creatives and designers. Help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing managers sharpen their own briefs, bringing the concept, the hook and the cultural angle to the start of the process. Pitch original concepts for paid and social before anyone asks, so ideas reach the team already sharp. Make your own content for paid and organic. The format is open: you could be a meme machine, an AI video specialist, someone who performs to camera, or something we haven’t thought of. What matters is that it feels native to the feed and ships fast. Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response. React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself. Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea. Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on. What You Bring 5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category. A portfolio submitted with your application. Include two or three concept-led briefs or concept decks, with what shipped and how it performed where you’re able to share it, plus work you made yourself in the formats that are your strength. Include one idea you spotted in culture or data and took to market, with a short note on what the results told you and what you changed. A proactive, self-starting way of working. You find the idea, pitch it and drive it to be shipped without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable owning your workflow with light direction. Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated. A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it. A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it. Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one. Fluency in the metrics creative moves, and the habit of using performance data and social listening as inputs to ideas. A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon. Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with concepts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements. Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. review_candidates.description: Apply now » Date: 5 Oct 2026 Location: Phnom Penh, Cambodia Company: Plan International The Organisation Plan International is a rights-based development and humanitarian organisation working for better lives for all children. We are independent of government and have no political or religious affiliation. Our purpose is to strive for a just world that advances children’s rights and equality for girls. We have been building powerful partnerships for children for more than 80 years, and are now active in more than 70 countries. Our global strategy has a specific focus on girls, as they are often the most marginalised and most often left behind. We have committed ourselves to the ambitious target of reaching 100 million girls over 5 years, to ensure they can learn, lead, decide and thrive. This is our contribution to reaching the sustainable development goals, and in particular the goals on gender equality. Our organisation is transforming itself to meet this enormous challenge everywhere we work. We need bold, forward-thinking and innovative individuals to lead our country operations, driving change and delivering results that will allow us to reach our target of 100 million girls. The Opportunity Plan International is seeking an experienced, values-driven and strategic leader to serve as Country Director for Cambodia. This is a pivotal leadership role, responsible for setting the overall direction of Plan International’s work in Cambodia and ensuring strong programme delivery, influencing impact and sustainable organisational performance. As Country Director, you will lead a team of about 80 staff and oversee a country programme with an annual budget of approximately USD 8 million. You will represent Plan International at senior levels with government, donors, civil society, media and partners, while ensuring the organisation delivers relevant, gender-transformative impact for the most vulnerable children, particularly girls. This role requires a leader who is comfortable driving transformative change, strengthening organisational culture and accountability, and ensuring that Plan International Cambodia remains a credible, influential and effective development and humanitarian actor. In This Pivotal Role, You Will Provide strategic and operational leadership for Plan International’s development, humanitarian and influencing work in Cambodia, aligned with the global strategy and the organisation’s commitment to gender equality and girls’ rights. Lead the development and implementation of an ambitious Country Strategy grounded in gender transformation, child rights and participation. Ensure programme and influencing work achieves impact at scale by linking grassroots action with national-level influencing and advocacy. Drive effective emergency preparedness, risk reduction and resilience building, and ensure readiness to respond to both predictable and sudden-onset emergencies. Strengthen resource mobilisation across institutional, multilateral, corporate and National Office funding sources, ensuring long-term sustainability. Lead and develop a high-performing, inclusive and values-driven team, embedding Plan International’s standards on safeguarding, gender equality, accountability and ethical practice. Ensure strong financial stewardship, legal and donor compliance, and effective planning, budgeting, reporting and performance management systems. Act as Plan International’s senior in-country representative, building trusted relationships with government, donors, media, INGOs, national NGOs, communities and other stakeholders. Contribute as an active member of the Regional Leadership Team, supporting regional collaboration, organisational learning and shared services. Do you have what it takes? To excel in this role, you will need among other things: Proven senior leadership experience with increasing responsibility in an international development environment. A strong understanding of child rights, gender in development and girls’ rights, and the ability to translate these commitments into impactful programmes and influencing strategies. Experience in sustainable community development and participatory approaches in development interventions. Knowledge of donor compliance requirements and sound financial management. Experience of programming in challenging environments, with a strong understanding of the political, social, economic, humanitarian and security context in Cambodia or a comparable environment. Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate diverse teams, manage organisational change, and build an efficient and motivated workforce. Strong political acumen, networking and negotiation skills, with experience engaging governmental and non-governmental actors. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Khmer, with strong diplomatic and media-facing communication skills. A relevant university degree in development, social science, business administration or a related field.
